courses.summary: 以加拿大山區地下金礦為例，研究取樣代表性、冬季水量與深部物流。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A Canadian mountain underground gold case examines sampling representativeness, winter water and deep logistics. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
